comment:
* A base class for {@link Preference} objects that are
 * dialog-based. These preferences will, when clicked, open a dialog showing the
 * actual preference controls.
 *
 * @attr name android:dialogTitle
 * @attr name android:dialogMessage
 * @attr name android:dialogIcon
 * @attr name android:dialogLayout
 * @attr name android:positiveButtonText
 * @attr name android:negativeButtonText

methods.name: public void setDialogTitle(CharSequence dialogTitle)
methods.comment:
* Sets the title of the dialog. This will be shown on subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param dialogTitle The title.

methods.name: public void setDialogTitle(int dialogTitleResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setDialogTitle(CharSequence)
     * @param dialogTitleResId The dialog title as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getDialogTitle()
methods.comment:
* Returns the title to be shown on subsequent dialogs.
     * @return The title.

methods.name: public void setDialogMessage(CharSequence dialogMessage)
methods.comment:
* Sets the message of the dialog. This will be shown on subsequent dialogs. *

* This message forms the content View of the dialog and conflicts with * list-based dialogs, for example. If setting a custom View on a dialog via * {@link #setDialogLayoutResource(int)}, include a text View with ID * {@link android.R.id#message} and it will be populated with this message. * * @param dialogMessage The message.

methods.name: public void setDialogMessage(int dialogMessageResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setDialogMessage(CharSequence)
     * @param dialogMessageResId The dialog message as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getDialogMessage()
methods.comment:
* Returns the message to be shown on subsequent dialogs.
     * @return The message.

methods.name: public void setDialogIcon(Drawable dialogIcon)
methods.comment:
* Sets the icon of the dialog. This will be shown on subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param dialogIcon The icon, as a {@link Drawable}.

methods.name: public void setDialogIcon(int dialogIconRes)
methods.comment:
* Sets the icon (resource ID) of the dialog. This will be shown on
     * subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param dialogIconRes The icon, as a resource ID.

methods.name: public Drawable getDialogIcon()
methods.comment:
* Returns the icon to be shown on subsequent dialogs.
     * @return The icon, as a {@link Drawable}.

methods.name: public void setPositiveButtonText(CharSequence positiveButtonText)
methods.comment:
* Sets the text of the positive button of the dialog. This will be shown on
     * subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param positiveButtonText The text of the positive button.

methods.name: public void setPositiveButtonText(int positiveButtonTextResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setPositiveButtonText(CharSequence)
     * @param positiveButtonTextResId The positive button text as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getPositiveButtonText()
methods.comment:
* Returns the text of the positive button to be shown on subsequent
     * dialogs.
     *
     * @return The text of the positive button.

methods.name: public void setNegativeButtonText(CharSequence negativeButtonText)
methods.comment:
* Sets the text of the negative button of the dialog. This will be shown on
     * subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param negativeButtonText The text of the negative button.

methods.name: public void setNegativeButtonText(int negativeButtonTextResId)
methods.comment:
* @see #setNegativeButtonText(CharSequence)
     * @param negativeButtonTextResId The negative button text as a resource.

methods.name: public CharSequence getNegativeButtonText()
methods.comment:
* Returns the text of the negative button to be shown on subsequent
     * dialogs.
     *
     * @return The text of the negative button.

methods.name: public void setDialogLayoutResource(int dialogLayoutResId)
methods.comment:
* Sets the layout resource that is inflated as the {@link View} to be shown
     * as the content View of subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @param dialogLayoutResId The layout resource ID to be inflated.
     * @see #setDialogMessage(CharSequence)

methods.name: public int getDialogLayoutResource()
methods.comment:
* Returns the layout resource that is used as the content View for
     * subsequent dialogs.
     *
     * @return The layout resource.
